hero.title: Toll Brothers Digital Studio
hero.subtitle: Showcasing three home customization tools for the Toll Brothers Studio app

sections.intro: Toll Brothers traditionally relied on outdated digital modules and PDFs to deliver home customization options. The new **Digital Studio** app is a comprehensive digital home customization platform. I led end-to-end design on three major modules for the app: **Floor Plan Configurator**, **Collection Builder** (internal-facing), and the **Digital Catalog**.

frames.text:
The digital Floor Plan Configurator helps homebuyers understand and pre-select architectural customization options. Research reported that homebuyers found the old module difficult to use and needed in-person guidance to understand options.

1. Failed to communicate complex option dependencies.
2. Relied on trial-and-error with dense tooltips.
3. Built on desktop-first principles with limited mobile support.

To understand the full scope of option relationships, I researched 80 floor plans with the most complicated setups.

frames.header: New Floor Plan Option Visualization System
frames.text: I designed a modular component system that grouped and visualized dependencies and constraints. Based on the floor plan research, I adapted the design to accomodate for complex edge-cases such as combination and assymetric constraint groups. Stakeholders approved the framework. I then redesigned the module on mobile-first principles.

Traditionally, the merchandising team manually curated design options in PDFs. Now that the Studio app promised digital delivery of these options, the team needed a tool to digitally curate collections of options. I conducted research into the merchandising team's workflows and defined the main MVP requirements:

1. User can create and manage collections of options.
2. User can upload and manage options, either through UI or CSV/spreadsheet uploads.
3. System should have duplication guardrails on data entry.

Since there was no pre-existing tool, I created wireframes that focus on the editing flow of creating a new collection.

1. **Main** shows all the collections.
2. **Collection** shows all options in a single collection, separated by rooms (kitchen, primary bath, etc…)
3. **Selecting** allows users to select options for a single room.
4. **Uploading** allows users to add new options into the library.
